Package com.egradx.observability

Class EgradxTagRules

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.observability.EgradxTagRules
public final class EgradxTagRules extends Object
What may be a metric name or a metric tag, checked on every call so that a mistake fails a test instead of taking down a metrics backend.

Every distinct combination of tag values is a separate time series, held in memory by the application and by Prometheus for as long as it exists. A tag whose values are unbounded — an organization id, a user id, a request id — grows that set without limit, and ids and addresses are personal data besides. They belong on spans (high-cardinality key values), where each value lives in one trace, never on meters. So:

  • names start with egradx., so every egradx meter is found in one place;
  • tag keys that name an id, an address, a URL or a path are refused;
  • values that look like a UUID, or are longer than 64 characters, are refused — whatever the key is called.
Violations throw IllegalArgumentException: they are programming errors, and the values that reach tags (channel ids, outcomes, states) come from code and configuration, not users.
